definition: the clear liquid you drink that has no colour or taste
exampleSentence: Can I have a glass of water, please?
exampleTranslation: Cho tôi xin một cốc nước nhé?

definition: water from under the ground that is sold in bottles
exampleSentence: I always drink mineral water with my lunch.
exampleTranslation: Tôi luôn uống nước khoáng trong bữa trưa.

definition: a hot drink made by pouring hot water on dried leaves
exampleSentence: Do you take milk and sugar in your tea?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có uống trà với sữa và đường không?

definition: light-coloured tea made from leaves heated with steam
exampleSentence: My grandmother drinks green tea every morning.
exampleTranslation: Bà tôi uống trà xanh mỗi sáng.

definition: a hot dark brown drink with a slightly bitter taste
exampleSentence: Do you want a cup of coffee?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có muốn một tách cà phê không?

definition: strong black Italian coffee, or a cup of it
exampleSentence: I'll have an espresso, please.
exampleTranslation: Cho tôi một ly espresso nhé.

definition: Italian coffee made with hot milk and chocolate powder on top
exampleSentence: Two cappuccinos, please.
exampleTranslation: Cho tôi hai ly cappuccino.

definition: strong coffee with a lot of hot milk in it
exampleSentence: I ordered a large latte at the cafe.
exampleTranslation: Tôi gọi một ly latte lớn ở quán cà phê.

definition: a hot drink made with chocolate powder and milk or water
exampleSentence: The children want hot chocolate after school.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ muốn uống sô-cô-la nóng sau giờ học.

definition: a sweet drink made of milk, ice cream and fruit or chocolate
exampleSentence: I'd like a chocolate milk shake.
exampleTranslation: Tôi muốn một ly sữa lắc sô-cô-la.

definition: a thick drink made of fruit mixed with juice, ice or milk
exampleSentence: This strawberry smoothie is really good.
exampleTranslation: Ly sinh tố dâu này ngon thật.

definition: a sweet drink made from lemons, sugar and water
exampleSentence: We sold lemonade on the street in summer.
exampleTranslation: Mùa hè chúng tôi bán nước chanh bên đường.

definition: a brown sweet fizzy drink, or a can or glass of it
exampleSentence: I drank a can of cola.
exampleTranslation: Tôi uống một lon cô-ca.

definition: a sweet fizzy drink, or a can or bottle of it
exampleSentence: There is a cooler full of soda at the party.
exampleTranslation: Ở bữa tiệc có một thùng lạnh đầy nước ngọt có ga.

definition: a cold drink that does not contain alcohol
exampleSentence: Soft drinks are not good for your teeth.
exampleTranslation: Nước ngọt không tốt cho răng.

definition: a sweet drink with bubbles of gas, without alcohol
translation: nước ngọt có ga, nước có ga
exampleSentence: I don't like fizzy drinks.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không thích nước ngọt có ga.

definition: a clear bitter drink that you can mix with alcohol
exampleSentence: I ordered a gin and tonic.
exampleTranslation: Tôi gọi một ly gin tonic.

definition: water that has frozen into a solid
exampleSentence: Would you like some ice in your drink?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có muốn cho đá vào đồ uống không?

definition: a small block of ice used to make drinks cold
exampleSentence: Put two ice cubes in my glass, please.
exampleTranslation: Cho hai viên đá vào ly của tôi nhé.

definition: a thin tube you use to suck up a drink
exampleSentence: I drank my lemonade through a straw.
exampleTranslation: Tôi uống nước chanh bằng ống hút.

definition: an alcoholic drink made from malt and hops
exampleSentence: Do you fancy a cold beer?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có muốn một chai bia lạnh không?

definition: an alcoholic drink made from grapes
exampleSentence: We had a bottle of red wine with dinner.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi uống một chai rượu vang đỏ với bữa tối.

definition: a French white wine with bubbles, drunk on special occasions
exampleSentence: They opened champagne at the wedding.
exampleTranslation: Họ mở rượu sâm panh trong đám cưới.

definition: a strong alcoholic drink made from grain
exampleSentence: I poured a glass of whisky.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rót một ly whisky.

definition: a strong clear alcoholic drink from Russia
exampleSentence: They mixed vodka with orange juice.
exampleTranslation: Họ pha vodka với nước cam.

definition: an alcoholic drink made by mixing different drinks
exampleSentence: We ordered two cocktails at the bar.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi gọi hai ly cocktail ở quầy bar.

definition: drinks such as beer or wine that can make you drunk
translation: rượu bia, đồ uống có cồn
exampleSentence: I don't drink alcohol.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không uống rượu bia.

definition: to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it
exampleSentence: You should drink plenty of water.
exampleTranslation: Bạn nên uống nhiều nước.

definition: to drink slowly, taking very small mouthfuls
exampleSentence: I sat sipping my coffee.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ngồi nhấp từng ngụm cà phê.

definition: to swallow a lot of drink or food quickly
exampleSentence: I gulped down my water and ran out.
exampleTranslation: Tôi uống ừng ực hết cốc nước rồi chạy ra ngoài.

definition: feeling that you want or need a drink
exampleSentence: I'm really thirsty. Can I have some water?
exampleTranslation: Tôi khát quá. Cho tôi xin ít nước được không?

definition: thin round pieces of fried potato eaten cold from a packet
translation: khoai tây chiên lát, snack khoai tây
exampleSentence: I ate a packet of crisps.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ăn hết một gói khoai tây chiên lát.

definition: corn that bursts open when heated, eaten as a snack
exampleSentence: Let's buy popcorn at the cinema.
exampleTranslation: Mình mua bắp rang ở rạp chiếu phim nhé.

definition: a small, thin, dry, usually sweet cake
exampleSentence: We had tea and biscuits.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi uống trà và ăn bánh quy.

definition: a small flat sweet cake
exampleSentence: Would you like a glass of milk and a cookie?
exampleTranslation: Bạn muốn một ly sữa và một chiếc bánh quy không?

definition: a hard dry bread in small flat pieces, often eaten with cheese
translation: bánh quy giòn mặn, bánh cracker
exampleSentence: I like cheese and crackers.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích ăn phô mai với bánh cracker.

definition: a sweet you chew for a long time but do not swallow
exampleSentence: Please don't stick chewing gum under the table.
exampleTranslation: Làm ơn đừng dán kẹo cao su dưới bàn.

definition: a sweet food made from sugar or chocolate
exampleSentence: Do you want a piece of candy?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có muốn một viên kẹo không?

definition: small pieces of sweet food made from sugar or chocolate
exampleSentence: Eating too many sweets is bad for your teeth.
exampleTranslation: Ăn nhiều kẹo quá có hại cho răng.

definition: a hard sweet on a stick
exampleSentence: The child wanted a red lollipop.
exampleTranslation: Đứa bé muốn một cây kẹo mút màu đỏ.

definition: a piece of sweet frozen juice on a stick that you suck
exampleSentence: The children are eating ice lollies in the garden.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ đang ăn kem que ngoài vườn.

definition: a small round cake, often shaped like a ring
exampleSentence: I bought a doughnut at the bakery.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mua một cái bánh donut ở tiệm bánh.

definition: a curved sweet bread often eaten for breakfast
exampleSentence: I had a croissant and coffee for breakfast.
exampleTranslation: Bữa sáng tôi ăn bánh sừng bò và uống cà phê.

definition: a small sweet cake, sometimes with fruit in it
exampleSentence: I baked blueberry muffins this morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nay tôi nướng bánh muffin việt quất.

definition: a flat cake marked with a pattern of deep squares
exampleSentence: Would you like a waffle with ice cream?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có muốn bánh waffle với kem không?

definition: a pie without a top, with something sweet inside
translation: bánh tart, bánh nướng nhân trái cây
exampleSentence: I made an apple tart for dessert.
exampleTranslation: Tôi làm một cái bánh tart táo để tráng miệng.

definition: a small sweet cake made with a mixture of flour and butter
exampleSentence: There is a good bakery with fresh pastries.
exampleTranslation: Có một tiệm bánh ngon với bánh ngọt mới làm.

definition: a soft sweet food made by baking flour, butter, sugar and eggs
exampleSentence: We had cake and ice cream at the party.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn bánh ngọt và kem ở bữa tiệc.

definition: a small round cake
exampleSentence: Every guest got a chocolate cupcake.
exampleTranslation: Mỗi khách đều nhận được một cái bánh cupcake sô-cô-la.

definition: a cake made with soft cheese
exampleSentence: I'd like a slice of cheesecake, please.
exampleTranslation: Cho tôi một miếng bánh phô mai nhé.

definition: a thick flat chocolate cake
exampleSentence: The brownies are still warm.
exampleTranslation: Mấy cái bánh brownie vẫn còn ấm.

definition: a thick sweet creamy dish, often served cold
exampleSentence: We had chocolate pudding for dessert.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn pudding sô-cô-la tráng miệng.

definition: a soft sweet food made from fruit juice
exampleSentence: The children love strawberry jelly.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ rất thích thạch dâu.

definition: a sweet yellow sauce made with milk, sugar and eggs
exampleSentence: Apple pie with custard is my favourite.
exampleTranslation: Bánh táo với sốt custard là món tôi thích nhất.

definition: a dish made from ice cream, fruit, sweet sauce and nuts
exampleSentence: I'd like a chocolate sundae.
exampleTranslation: Tôi muốn một ly kem sundae sô-cô-la.
